name: PaymentApplicationBuilder
tagline: Construction progress billing – schedule of values, retainage, certification and payment – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete payment application (pay app) module for contractors and subcontractors: a schedule of values continuation sheet with previous, this period and stored materials, % complete and balance to finish; retainage with automatic reduction; a G702-style summary with previous certificates and current payment due; submit checks (balanced SOV, no over-billing, lien waiver, one open application per contract), review, independent certification with reduced amounts, return, payment and void; dashboard, application register and contract progress with S-curves. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen and connects to any collection, Dataverse view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Continuation sheet entry by amount or % complete
Retainage reduction at a set % complete
Previous certificates calculated from earlier periods
Carry forward to the next period
Submit checklist: balanced SOV, over-billing, lien waiver, open previous application
Independent certification and reduced certificates with reasons
Bulk submit / review / certify / pay / return
CSV export of the register and the continuation sheet
